author: jmaximusg
quote: Thirteen years. THIRTEEN YEARS of waiting, and Rockstar hands us an $80 TED Talk with a wanted level.Remember when GTA was the most unapologetic game on the planet? When it roasted everybody equally and didn't flinch? That studio is gone. What's left is a corporate committee that plays it so safe you can practically hear the HR department breathing over your shoulder every time you load a save.Lucia had real potential. Instead of a ruthless criminal, she feels engineered to tick boxes. Jason? Basically a sidekick in his own game. Every cutscene plays like it got focus-grouped in a conference room in front of a "messaging" **** satire used to have teeth. Now it punches in one direction and calls that "edgy." GTA's whole identity was that nothing was off-limits. Now everything is, unless it's the approved target of the **** Vice City? Gorgeous. Seriously, the best-looking city ever made. Too bad it's a stunning set for a show nobody asked for.Rockstar, you had the biggest launch in entertainment history and you blinked. You traded the chaos, the dark humor, and the freedom that made this series legendary for a sermon. Fans didn't wait over a decade to get lectured. We waited to get unhinged.Save your $80. Reinstall San Andreas. It still has more guts than this entire game.
